from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full official title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) identified in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The general nature of the case (e.g., 行政，民事，刑事)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted documents for the given task."""
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
